About.title: Reinventing institutional finance with regulated programmability
About.paragraph1: Remi is regulated stablecoin infrastructure built for financial institutions. We believe the future of digital finance must be interoperable, auditable and compliant — so we built an orchestration layer that unifies settlement, compliance and treasury for banks.
About.paragraph2: Today Remi serves more than 200 banks and financial institutions across 60+ countries. Our infrastructure carries billions of dollars in real transactions every day, running 24/7 with 99.99% availability.

value1.title: Compliance first
value1.desc: Programmable compliance baked into every transaction journey — regulation as a default capability, not an afterthought.

value2.title: Institutional-grade reliability
value2.desc: 99.99% availability and end-to-end auditability, carrying real-world financial flow.

value3.title: Open interoperability
value3.desc: Open standards that connect existing payment, clearing and custody systems — not another silo.

value4.title: Long-termism
value4.desc: Building a sustainable digital finance foundation with regulators, banks and ecosystem partners.
